anatomy.//: What is under the skin, by depth from the surface, baked into the .vox by `node scripts/anatomize_mob.mjs <mob>` or the tuner's Apply recipe button (assets/editor/anatomy.js documents the format). Materials by NAME. `keep` leaves the painted surface alone; `garments` are surface voxels that are clothes, so the voxel under them is skin. Head override: a bone skull two deep around a `brain` core.
